title: Gane.io
tagline: G.A.N.E. - Game Accounts Now Exchangable (A one stop gaming solution for selling game accounts)
description:
- making the process legit for selling game accounts(in web2 and web3 as well) 
- to prevent malicious activities in which users retrieves back their password even after selling their game account to another user
- helps gaming studios incentivised to generate more revenue on top of selling accounts
